choice.basis: The dashboard's printed title explicitly states 'Increasing River Restoration Capacity from 2018 to 2023'. While the visual data shows a drop from the 2018 peak to the 2023 level, the title serves as the intended summary of the overall trend for the review window. The option 'restoration capacity expansion follow-up' directly corresponds to the 'increasing' trend described in the title.
choice.option_label: Route the record to restoration capacity expansion follow-up
